title: Cost to Message London Is Exorbitant
version: 2020 republication of a Scientific American report attributed to August 1866
lineage: Publisher’s 2020 republication of its dated 1866 report, not an independently inspected original 1866 issue. The article reports a charge and schedule; it does not establish settlement, the exact message date or the first commercial transaction.

passages.note: Reproduced August 1866 paragraph: 20-word London message, published tariff, charge of £24
